name: Muriyari de mo Kanjichau Inran Tosho Iin
original_name: ムリやりでも感じちゃう淫乱図書委員
source:
A serious, studious girl named Shiori worked at the
school library. One day she learned a forbidden kind of play.
When no one was around she began to masturbate...
thinking of her sempai... but she wasn't alone after all. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE081517.html]English DLSite[/url]]
translation:
认真好学的女孩押花志保里在学校图书馆工作。某天，她学会了一种禁忌玩法。四下无人时，她一边想着学长，一边开始自慰……可原来，她并不是独自一人。

[译自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE081517.html]DLsite English[/url]]
